|---|---|---|

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scarce; low score associated with non-invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 3, 9) · ↓ invasive · High score; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 0, 3, 4) · context · Smallest mean size, widest size variation in reference set; sampled regions only · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Mitotic figures Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Duct-confined score is high but only Weak; in-situ disease may be underweighted.
- Image is atypical versus calibration set (OOD 98th percentile) despite reliability 0.999.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 9** — Confirm atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
2. **Regions 0, 8** — Only regions with positive invasive contribution; verify necrosis.
3. **Region 3** — Review nuclear size variation; most sampled nuclei come from here.
